$comment: Choices the studio's Settings > Stream page offers (D327, OS1). UI choices only: platform limits stay in data/platforms/*.json and are checked by services/outputs/validate.mjs, never here. videoBitrateKbps bounds are what the bitrate box accepts, not a platform limit. Quality presets map to the host's encoder presets (NVENC p1-p7, x264 ultrafast-medium). seedPlan: the live plan a new stream setup starts from; its rung values are copied, never guessed. qualityKeys + platforms[].keyPerQuality (D385): a platform that gives a stream key per resolution (YouTube: 1080p, 2K and 4K keys made in YouTube Studio) uses the key Ujwalam/stream/<output>-<quality id> when the output is sent at that size or larger (short side), else Ujwalam/stream/<output>.
